input.summary: Use the top lanes to build base bonus and PHOENIX progress, complete either four-bank until Bonus X reaches 5x, then shoot the bullseye only after its rebound is safe.

quickInfo.name: Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Lanes and targets build base bonus to 29,000, and 5x Bonus produces a maximum 145,000 collect.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Each completion of either four-bank advances Bonus X toward 5x.

quickInfo.name: A and B targets
quickInfo.summary: Each center target scores 10,000 and one bonus advance, then remains down until its matching lane relights it.

quickInfo.name: PHOENIX bullseye
quickInfo.summary: Each 1-through-5 lane completion adds a PHOENIX letter and raises the bullseye to the displayed letter value.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinner
quickInfo.summary: The left spinner lights only while base bonus is from 10,000 through 20,000.

steps.text: On ball one, plunge for top lane 1. On later plunges, choose a missing 1-through-5 lane.
Send the ball to the top. Use the lanes to build base bonus and advance the 1-through-5 set.
Complete the safer four-bank. Repeat bank completions until Bonus X reaches 5x.
Shoot the left spinner while base bonus is from 10,000 through 20,000.
Use the A and B center targets for 10,000 only from a controlled feed. Relight A with top lane 2 or the left return lane.
Relight B with top lane 4 or the right return lane. Shoot the PHOENIX bullseye only after its rebound is known.

fallback.title: A-B and lit spinner
fallback.when: Use this when drop-bank or bullseye rebounds are not safe.

steps.text: Collect A or B from a controlled flipper for 10,000 and one bonus advance.
Return the ball to the top to relight the collected target.
Use the left spinner while base bonus is in its lit range.
Protect the built bonus instead of forcing the four-banks.

alternatives.title: PHOENIX bullseye route
alternatives.when: Use this only when the bullseye rebound is safe on this machine.

steps.text: Complete the 1-through-5 lanes to add one PHOENIX letter.
Repeat the lane set to raise the displayed bullseye value.
Shoot the bullseye from control.
Stop if its rebound reaches the center or an outlane.
Score top lanes, return lanes, and targets until base bonus reaches 29,000.
Complete either four-bank until Bonus X reaches 5x.
Complete 1-through-5 sets to add PHOENIX letters.
Shoot the bullseye to collect its displayed PHOENIX value only when the return is controlled.

playfieldReferences.label: Lane 1
playfieldReferences.description: The top lane targeted by the preferred skill plunge.

playfieldReferences.label: Bullseye target
playfieldReferences.description: The center target whose return must be tested before repeated shots.

techniques.name: Lane-1 skill shot
techniques.instruction: On ball one, adjust the plunge for lane 1. This is the only lane in the 1-through-5 set that is available only at the top.

techniques.name: Bullseye-return test
techniques.instruction: Watch whether the upper-left drop changes the bullseye rebound. Leave that drop standing or remove it based on the safer result.

cautions.issue: The PHOENIX bullseye can return directly toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Test the rebound before you build around this shot. Use top play if the return is not controlled.

cautions.issue: The four-bank targets are required for Bonus X but can give dangerous rebounds.
cautions.response: Use the safer bank. Stop direct target play when a rebound reaches the center or an outlane.

cautions.issue: Bumper exits can make the ball move quickly toward the lower playfield.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready after every top shot. Nudge before the ball reaches the slingshots.

input.simpleOverview: Phoenix builds a 29,000 base bonus through lanes and targets, while either four-bank advances Bonus X to 5x. Build both values, use the 1-through-5 lanes to add P-H-O-E-N-I-X letters, and shoot the bullseye only after its return is proven.
input.overview: Phoenix builds a 29,000 base bonus through lanes and targets, while either four-bank advances Bonus X to 5x. Build base and multiplier together, using the A and B targets when they are relit by their matching lanes. Add letters through complete 1-through-5 sets, then convert the bullseye value only from a controlled angle and preserve the 145,000 end-of-ball bonus.
